critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and well-structured. InvoiceCreate.js (493 lines) and InvoiceDetail.js (777 lines) — InvoiceDetail.js exceeds the 700-line soft limit but is well-organized; splitting into sub-components (InvoiceView, EditSitesForm, BankDetailsCard) is already done
Good: cascade_delete_invoice() correctly removes invoice_sites and invoice_items on DELETE
Good: create_sites_and_items() correctly calculates subtotals and grand total
Good: enrich_invoice() correctly joins client data on every GET/PUT response
Good: generate_invoice_id() uses regex sort+increment for sequential INV numbering
Good: All status transitions work correctly (draft→sent→paid/overdue)
Good: DELETE endpoint rejects non-draft invoices with 400 and 'Only draft invoices can be deleted' message
Minor: EditSitesForm in InvoiceDetail.js lacks data-testid on rate/qty inputs (uses generic number inputs), making automated test targeting less precise — not blocking
